safetyNotes: Print PRT-01 (Base Hub), PRT-02 (Ratchet Hinge), and PRT-04 (Upper Clamp Jaw) in PETG with 4 perimeter walls and 35% gyroid infill for high clamping stiffness.
All T-slot sliding rails include a 0.25mm lateral clearance so carriages glide smoothly along the 2020 aluminum profile without binding.

steps.title: Step 1: Install Weighted H-Frame Studio Base Hub & Non-Slip EPDM Rubber Foot Pads & Canvas Jaw Cushions (8-Pack)
steps.note: Wide-stance H-frame base block with recessed EPDM foot pockets and dual hinge clevis ears. Anchors the easel to the tabletop and houses the lower tilt hinge pivot.
steps.description: Wide-stance H-frame base block with recessed EPDM foot pockets and dual hinge clevis ears. Anchors the easel to the tabletop and houses the lower tilt hinge pivot.

steps.title: Step 2: Install 15°-Step Ratcheting Tilt Mast Hinge & 2020 Black Anodized V-Slot Aluminum Extrusion (400mm) & 302 Stainless Compression Detent Spring (8mm OD × 25mm)
steps.note: Toothed quadrant hinge socket that grips the bottom of the 2020 aluminum mast and locks tilt angle. Couples the 2020 aluminum spine to the base hub with positive angular indexing.
steps.description: Toothed quadrant hinge socket that grips the bottom of the 2020 aluminum mast and locks tilt angle. Couples the 2020 aluminum spine to the base hub with positive angular indexing.

steps.title: Step 3: Install 2020 V-Slot Rear Strut Locking Collar & M5×20mm Stainless Socket Cap Screws & 2020 Roll-In T-Nuts
steps.note: Sliding rear collar that braces the mast tilt quadrant against brush pressure. Reinforces mast inclination angle on the rear V-slot channel.
steps.description: Sliding rear collar that braces the mast tilt quadrant against brush pressure. Reinforces mast inclination angle on the rear V-slot channel.

steps.title: Step 4: Install Lower Canvas Ledge & Brush Rest Tray
steps.note: Full-width lower support shelf with integrated brush groove and 2020 V-slot tongue. Supports the bottom edge of the canvas and slides vertically on the 2020 mast.
steps.description: Full-width lower support shelf with integrated brush groove and 2020 V-slot tongue. Supports the bottom edge of the canvas and slides vertically on the 2020 mast.

steps.title: Step 5: Install Sliding Top Canvas Clamp Jaw
steps.note: Inverted L-jaw carriage that clamps the top stretcher bar of the canvas without marring paint. Locks top canvas edge against the 2020 mast via an M5 T-nut.
steps.description: Inverted L-jaw carriage that clamps the top stretcher bar of the canvas without marring paint. Locks top canvas edge against the 2020 mast via an M5 T-nut.

steps.title: Step 6: Install Lobed M5 Brass-Insert Rosette Knobs (×3) & M5×0.8mm Solid Brass Knurled Thumb Nuts & Inserts (10-Pack)
steps.note: Six-lobe ergonomic hand knobs with hex pockets for M5 brass thumb nuts. Provides tool-free locking for the tilt hinge, lower tray, and top canvas clamp.
steps.description: Six-lobe ergonomic hand knobs with hex pockets for M5 brass thumb nuts. Provides tool-free locking for the tilt hinge, lower tray, and top canvas clamp.
